name: Emery
detailed_description:
Dive into a whimsical 3D platformer where adventure, puzzles, and exploration collide! Step into the feathers of a brave red bird on his quest.

Explore lush, hand-crafted worlds filled with challenges, quirky characters, and magical secrets. Armed with an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities, tackle a variety of platforming puzzles, face off against mischievous enemy's, and collect shiny treasures to unlock the path the top.

🦅 A Hero’s Journey: Step into the feathers of a brave and spirited red bird. Soar through challenges, face daring foes, and uncover the hidden treasures to save the day

🌳 Open-World Exploration: Start your journey  and carve your path through themed worlds brimming with hidden collectibles, clever puzzles, and fearsome foes.

🦉 Crazy Cast of Characters: Meet or beat a huge cast of memorable characters in this brand new adventure

💥 Unlock and Master Moves: Master an array of dynamic abilities as you navigate vibrant, interconnected worlds, overcoming challenges and uncovering hidden secrets along the way

🎨 Cartoony Charm: A playful, hand-drawn art style with quirky characters to bring your adventure to life.

Prepare for an unforgettable adventure with our Red Feathered Hero!


''We’re thrilled to share a glimpse of Emery with you! While the game is still in active development, we’re working hard to ensure it’s the best it can be—refining mechanics, polishing visuals, and adding those magical finishing touches.''

"Please note: These are prototype images and do not reflect the final quality of the game. We're working hard to enhance every aspect to bring you the best possible experience!"

short_description: Emery is an all-new open-world 3D platformer from a indie developer passionate about the genre! Soar through vibrant, interconnected worlds, meet a charming cast of characters, and collect an array of treasures as the courageous red-feathered hero embarks on an epic quest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Additional Notes: Can be played with mouse and keyboard, but also with controller
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Additional Notes: Can be played with mouse and keyboard, but also with controller

mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14+
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
